fields.statement: QA at a191c9bf6 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath) in a hermetic scratch repo with a bare origin and a fake gh: rhiza daemon settings lists rhiza.ship.prePushCheck = "" (default, project) between localGate and generate; after rhiza daemon set rhiza.ship.prePushCheck '<cmd>' it lists the command (git config, project). go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/ship-prepush-check passed.

QA at a191c9bf6 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath) in a hermetic scratch repo with a bare origin and a fake gh: ship open-pr on a committed non-canonical log entry printed 'The pre-push check failed on 651ba2c, so nothing was pushed' with both rhiza check lines, exit 1, origin unchanged, gh only asked pr view; with the fix only in the working tree it still failed (exit 1, origin unchanged); with the fix committed and an untracked non-canonical .rhiza/log entry (worktree rhiza check exit 1) the check passed and 0503ee5 was pushed. ship rebase with a failing rhiza.ship.prePushCheck command printed the command's output (run in /tmp/rhiza-prepush-*), exit 1, branch back at its pre-merge head, origin unchanged. git worktree list showed no leftover checkout. Scoped tests TestShipPrePushCheck*, TestShipLocalGate*, TestWatchdogPRNoCI all PASS (package FAIL only from rootguard on ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json).

QA at a191c9bf6 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath) in a hermetic scratch repo with a bare origin and a fake gh: in a run (RHIZA_RUN with a journaled review), after the failed open-pr rhiza run status showed '## Pre-push check / - failed on 651ba2c (rhiza check)' and the failing lines; --json pre_push carried outcome failed, head, command 'rhiza check', output; after the passing push it showed outcome passed on 0503ee5. go test ./internal/run/... and TestScripts/run-status passed.

QA at a191c9bf6 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath) in a hermetic scratch repo with a bare origin and a fake gh: rhiza workflow describe ship-change shows open-pr on.fail -> open-pr-triage (on.pass gate-fix), land/push-merge to their triage, gate-fix prompt naming the pre-push lines in run status --json. After the failed open-pr, .git/rhiza/ship state held pre_push_failed=651ba2c and rhiza ship gate --failed exited 0; after HEAD moved it exited 1. go test ./internal/workflow/... and TestShipGate* passed.

QA at a191c9bf6 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath) in a hermetic scratch repo with a bare origin and a fake gh: rhiza workflow describe plan and plan-milestone list open-pr and rebase on.fail -> prepush-triage -> prepush-fix (agent, prompt says commit) -> open-pr. On open-pr's pre-push failure ship gate --failed exited 0, so the route reaches prepush-fix. But ship rebase failing its pre-push check (failing rhiza.ship.prePushCheck) puts the branch back at its pre-merge head and records no pre_push_failed, and ship gate --failed then exited 1 ('No head the local gate failed on after a rebase is on the branch'), so rebase's pre-push failure ends the run instead of reaching prepush-fix.
